facts.text: [A1] Full AC implies the countable-choice hypothesis of the unknotting-number definition. [[def-axiom-of-choice]], [[thm-choice-implies-dependent-implies-countable-choice]]

facts.label: F1
facts.text: [F1] The unknotting set is nonempty and $u(K)$ is its least element, measured by finite sequences of crossing changes in regular diagrams. [[def-knot-bridge-position-and-unknotting-number]]

facts.label: F2
facts.text: [F2] A single crossing change admits corresponding Seifert matrices with difference zero or $\pm vv^T$. [[lem-seifert-matrices-differ-rank-one-under-crossing-change]]

facts.label: F3
facts.text: [F3] Two Hermitian matrices differing by rank at most one have signatures differing by at most two, with zero eigenvalues omitted. [[lem-rank-one-hermitian-signature-perturbation]]

facts.label: F4
facts.text: [F4] The positive-push matrix gives $H_{-1}(V)=2(V+V^T)$; surface and basis changes preserve its signature. At a nonroot this is the declared invariant $\sigma_{-1}$. [[def-levine-tristram-hermitian-form-and-signature]], [[lem-seifert-stabilization-preserves-levine-tristram-signature]], [[lem-levine-tristram-hermitian-form-singular-set]]

facts.label: F5
facts.text: [F5] The skew part $V-V^T$ is the unimodular intersection pairing of a knot Seifert surface. [[lem-seifert-matrix-skew-part-is-surface-intersection]]

facts.label: A1
facts.text: [A1] The Axiom of Countable Choice, written $\mathrm{AC}_\omega$. [[def-countable-choice]]

facts.label: F1
facts.text: [F1] Bridge number is the minimum number of local maxima in a Morse representative for the fixed standard height. [[def-knot-bridge-position-and-unknotting-number]]

facts.label: F2
facts.text: [F2] Unknotting number is the minimum number of crossing changes from a regular diagram of the knot to a diagram of the fixed standard unknot. A regular diagram records its transverse double points, strand orientations and over/under data. [[def-knot-bridge-position-and-unknotting-number]], [[def-regular-oriented-link-diagram]]

facts.label: F3
facts.text: [F3] A valid finite planar code gives one positive-meridian generator per under-arc and one crossing conjugacy relator per crossing; the crossing-free one-component code has one generator and no relators, and the resulting presentation maps isomorphically to the knot group. [[def-knot-planar-code]], [[alg-knot-wirtinger-presentation-from-code]], [[thm-knot-wirtinger-presentation-correctness]]

facts.label: F4
facts.text: [F4] At every oriented crossing, if $s$ and $t$ are the source and target under-sides determined by the positive in-plane normal of the over-strand, then $m_t=m_o^{-1}m_s m_o$. [[lem-wirtinger-local-meridian-conjugacy]]

facts.label: F5
facts.text: [F5] An ambient isotopy ends at an orientation-preserving diffeomorphism, which is a homeomorphism; it induces an isomorphism of complement fundamental groups because the inverse diffeomorphism induces the inverse group map. [[def-oriented-link-in-s-three-and-ambient-isotopy]], [[def-diffeomorphism-and-local-diffeomorphism-of-manifolds]], [[def-based-loops-and-fundamental-group]], [[def-induced-homomorphism-on-fundamental-groups]], [[thm-induced-fundamental-group-map-functoriality]], [[def-group-isomorphism-and-automorphism]]

facts.label: F6
facts.text: [F6] Every oriented Reidemeister move on a regular diagram is realized by an ambient isotopy; in particular, oriented Reidemeister-II cancellation and Reidemeister-I curl deletion preserve the represented knot. [[def-oriented-reidemeister-moves]], [[lem-each-oriented-reidemeister-move-is-realized-by-ambient-isotopy]]

facts.label: F7
facts.text: [F7] Under $\mathrm{AC}_\omega$, a knot has bridge number one if and only if it is ambient isotopic to the fixed standard unknot. [[thm-bridge-one-is-unknot]]

facts.label: F8
facts.text: [F8] A group presentation $\langle a,b\mid r\rangle$ is the free group on $a,b$ modulo the normal closure of $r$. [[def-group-presentation]]

facts.label: F9
facts.text: [F9] Fundamental-group multiplication is associative and each loop class has the inverse represented by the reversed loop. [[thm-fundamental-group-laws]]

facts.label: F10
facts.text: [F10] A continuous real-valued function on a nonempty compact metric space attains a maximum. [[thm-extreme-value-metric]]

facts.label: F11
facts.text: [F11] The standard unit circle is the unit Euclidean sphere in $\mathbb R^2$ with its induced Euclidean metric. [[def-euclidean-spheres-and-closed-balls]]

facts.label: F12
facts.text: [F12] Every closed bounded subset of $\mathbb R^2$ is compact in the Euclidean metric. [[thm-heine-borel-rn]]

facts.label: F5
facts.text: [F5] A group homomorphism inducing an isomorphism on $H_1(-;\mathbb Z)$ and an epimorphism on $H_2(-;\mathbb Z)$ induces isomorphisms on every finite lower-central quotient, under the stated AC branch. [[thm-stallings-integral-lower-central-isomorphism]]

facts.label: A1
facts.text:
[A1] The Axiom of Choice, written AC, is [[def-axiom-of-choice]]. It supplies
countable choice through [[thm-choice-implies-dependent-implies-countable-choice]].

facts.label: F1
facts.text: [F1] [[lem-conway-seifert-surface-and-matrix]] constructs the actual embedded disk-and-band surface and an integral homology basis for the selected Conway diagram with the displayed matrix $V$, by a direct diagram transcription, local push-off counts and an explicit unimodular basis change.

facts.label: F2
facts.text:
[F2] [[thm-seifert-determinant-is-the-knot-alexander-polynomial]] identifies
the normalized Alexander polynomial with the determinant of a Seifert matrix
up to a unit $\pm t^m$ in $\mathbb Z[t,t^{-1}]$.

facts.label: F3
facts.text:
[F3] [[cor-knot-alexander-normalization-symmetry-and-genus-bound]]: every knot
Alexander generator has a unique symmetric unit associate taking value $1$ at
$t=1$.

facts.label: A1
facts.text: [A1] Full AC, written AC, is [[def-axiom-of-choice]].

facts.label: L1
facts.text:
[L1] AC supplies countable choice through
[[thm-choice-implies-dependent-implies-countable-choice]], which is used by
the handle and Lee branches.

facts.label: F1
facts.text: [F1] [[lem-conway-knot-alexander-polynomial-one]] gives the actual normalized equality $\Delta_C(t)=1$.

facts.label: F2
facts.text: [F2] [[thm-alexander-polynomial-one-implies-topologically-slice]]: under full AC, every smooth oriented Alexander-one knot bounds a locally flat proper disk in standard $B^4$. This is its smooth-input application; no broader TOP-generic disk-embedding assertion is used.

facts.label: F3
facts.text: [F3] [[def-locally-flat-proper-surface-and-concordance-collars]] fixes the proper local-flatness and boundary-collar conclusion.

facts.label: F4
facts.text: [F4] [[thm-knot-slice-iff-zero-trace-embeds-in-s-four]]: a smooth knot is smoothly slice if and only if its zero-trace smoothly embeds in standard $S^4$.

facts.label: F5
facts.text: [F5] [[lem-conway-has-an-explicit-zero-trace-partner-with-s-two]] supplies its explicitly specified alternate knot $Q$, the actual framed diffeomorphism $X_0(C)\cong X_0(Q)$, and $s(Q)=2$.

facts.label: F6
facts.text: [F6] [[thm-rasmussen-s-bounds-smooth-four-ball-genus]]: under countable choice, $|s(K)|\le2g_4^{\mathrm{sm}}(K)$, with its collared properly embedded cobordism hypotheses satisfied by an actual smooth slice disk.

facts.label: A1
facts.text:
[A1] Countable choice, written $\mathrm{AC}_\omega$, is
[[def-countable-choice]].

facts.label: F1
facts.text:
[F1] [[def-smooth-zero-trace]]: $X_0(U)$ is obtained by attaching a single
zero-framed $2$-handle to $B^4$ along $U$.

facts.label: F2
facts.text:
[F2] [[def-dualizable-handle-link]]: a dotted $R$ represents a $1$-handle,
and the meridional sublinks and zero mutual linking are the dualizability
conditions.

facts.label: F3
facts.text:
[F3] [[thm-handle-cancellation]]: a $1$-handle and $2$-handle with one
transverse attaching/belt-sphere intersection cancel, transporting remaining
attaching data.

facts.label: F4
facts.text:
[F4] [[thm-knot-slice-iff-zero-trace-embeds-in-s-four]]: a smooth slice disk
for $U$ gives a smooth embedding of $X_0(U)$ in $S^4$.

facts.label: A1
facts.text: [A1] [[def-countable-choice]] is assumed.

facts.label: F1
facts.text: [F1] [[def-smooth-knot-concordance]]: a smooth concordance is a properly embedded smooth annulus in $S^3\times[0,1]$ with product collars.

facts.label: F2
facts.text: [F2] [[lem-piccirillo-knot-lee-computations]] gives $s(C)=0$ by its direct Conway Lee computation. Only its Conway conclusion is used here.

facts.label: F3
facts.text: [F3] [[lem-lee-cobordism-filtration-genus-bound]] gives $|s(K_1)-s(K_0)|\le2g$ for an actual smoothly properly embedded oriented genus-$g$ cobordism with product collars.

facts.label: F4
facts.text: [F4] [[lem-conway-has-an-explicit-zero-trace-partner-with-s-two]] specifies $Q$ and proves $X_0(C)\cong X_0(Q)$ and $s(Q)=2$ by the actual framed trace and finite rational calculation.
